notes: Master (v1.0.2) = one of each card number per set/language (84 standard printings); holo / reverse-holo / stamp / code variations are Grand Master only. Grand = all rows. Deduplicated on name/set/num/language/variant; v1.0.2 dropped 5 duplicate rows (3 Holon Research Tower Quarter Decks listed twice; 2 extended cameo rows that duplicated the visually-verified addendum rows for Pikachu 028 and Thought Wave Machine 096 — their num format differed, '28' vs '028', so the earlier dedup missed them). Vending Series 2 Ditto #32 kept once (PokeCottage Glossy row); extended duplicate row dropped. Addendum merged Nov 26, 2026: +2 visually-verified cameos (Pikachu 028 30th Celebration, Thought Wave Machine Neo Destiny 096) and the Pikachu ex 149 image. Deliberately NOT merged: Shelmet Fusion Strike 013 (Ditto shape at top-left of art is ambiguous; addendum image URL pointed at Nincada swsh4-13 — correct art is swsh8-13), Influencer's Introduction (no image to verify the blanket claim), Machoke Expansion Sheet 3 (duplicate of the num-67 row), and all 8 Topps rows (same 8 cards as the extended list under different set names). Reverse holos added Nov 26, 2026 (v1.0.3): one Reverse Holo row for each of the ten Yuka Morii EX Delta Species Dittos (35-40, 61-64), English, Grand Master only — verified via PennySleeve finishes, TCGplayer printings, and the PSA registry (all ten have a Reverse Foil). Same art as the regular printing, so the image URL is shared.

merge_notes.name: Ditto
merge_notes.notes: Uncommon, on Sheet 3 (Rock Tunnel area). Japanese-only glossy stock. Numbering conflict: PokeCottage standard list uses 32 (pooka.app #32/36); other databases list 132/36 (Pokedex-based). Ditto appears ONLY in Series 2; Series 1 and 3 have no Ditto (Bulbapedia Vending Machine cards page). Image not verified — null.
